warnings: FireRed v1: no dynamic repoint-detection implemented for trainers/movesets/TMHM/evolutions yet (only FireRed 1.0(US) has it) -- those tables were not located; species/moves/abilities/encounters are unaffected.
gaps: trainers: trainerbattle opcodes now emit a real pbTrainerBattle call resolved via trainer_key (class, name, version); only double vs. single battle is inferred (tb_type==2), the other 9 GBA type bytes' extra semantics (e.g. tag partners, silhouette reveals) are not modeled

items: GBA item ids are resolved to Essentials InternalNames by reading each item's name straight out of the ROM's own item table (handles hack-renamed items, e.g. DBZ Team Training's 'Golden Caps.' for Master Ball) and matching it against vanilla + other mods' items.txt; additem/removeitem/pokemart use the real Essentials call for resolved ids -- items with no existing PBS match (genuinely new, hack-only items) have no stats/pocket/price/icon minting pipeline yet and fall back to a comment stub for just those ids (see items.unresolved count)

sprites: front battler art (spritesheets_base/{dex}.png) is extracted from the ROM's own pic+palette tables when both are structurally located (see sprites_extracted vs sprites_needed); icon sprites and the back-sprite table are not resolved -- icon-table candidates found by structural scan were indistinguishable/false-positive on the one ROM tried, and back-sprite art has no confirmed in-game consumer for a fused species -- ROM-hack originals also have no pokemondb.net source

abilities: a new ability (no name match to an existing PBS ability) gets a real PBS entry -- name + flavor description -- but no battle effect. Confirmed (ck32) this is a permanent Gen3 data-model limit, not an unbuilt feature: unlike moves' per-move effect byte or the evolution method field, vanilla Gen3 has no ability-effect table at all -- behavior is scattered ad-hoc engine checks, not decodable data -- so there's no ROM to extract this from on any hack, ever; see abilities.no_effect_handler count
evolutions: no evolution table located on this rom (neither the FR10 boot pointer nor the generic structural scan resolved one) -- extra_evolutions.txt is empty
